videos.title: Introducing Personal Finance in Claude
videos.description:
Get clear answers to the money questions you’ve never felt comfortable asking. Connect your accounts, and Claude explains your spending, bills, and balances in a way that makes sense.

Claude’s access is read-only. You pick the accounts and can unlink anytime.

Now in beta and rolling out gradually to Pro, Max and Ultra plans in the US:
https://claude.com/resources/articles/introducing-personal-finance-in-claude

analysis.summary: AI音声アシスタント機能を用いて、Claudeとの対話形式で個人の銀行口座などの資産管理を行う様子が映されています。
